evidence.detail: Exact S2C250 authority registers rs/n/c/ar as subtype 35 MAKE_X_QUANTITY_INTERFACE.
R5 MakeQuantityInterface constructs rs/n/c/ar as its static ScriptPacketHandler endpoint.
The handler configures exact quantity choices 1/5/10/X/All, item image/action rows, 'How many would you like to make?' prompt text, descriptive markup and per-slot timing/cooldown presentation.

proposals.note: Exact Make-X/quantity presentation handler; production-skill legality and item transformation remain server authority.

evidence.detail: Exact S2C250 authority registers rs/n/c/K as subtype 6 EVENT_ACTIVITY_TOKEN_LIMIT_STATE with title/text/count/token-limit/deadline payload.
R5 EventActivityViewerInterface constructs this handler as its static packet endpoint; sibling R285 EventActivityViewerRefreshTask owns periodic refresh presentation.
The handler clears/populates Event Activity viewer rows and updates the viewer's token/limit/timestamp state, matching the registered subtype contract.

proposals.note: Name follows the exact registered Event Activity viewer state endpoint rather than inventing an activity-domain service.

evidence.detail: The already-recovered ShopTabInterface constructs rs/n/c/aP as its sole static ScriptPacketHandler endpoint.
The handler reads a tab count followed by that many strings and passes the decoded array directly to ShopTabInterface tab-population logic.
Exact-current S2C250 authority identifies subtype 17 as shop-tab state.
Exact S2C250 authority registers rs/n/c/B as ScriptPacket subtype 28 CONFIRMATION_DIALOG_STATE with grammar u8 > u8 > i32_be > i32_be > u8 > i32_be > i32_be > u8.
ConfirmationDialogInterface constructs exactly one rs/n/c/B handler and exposes it as the dialog's packet/state controller.
The handler only mutates ConfirmationDialogInterface child positions/toggles and layout state; it owns no unrelated gameplay behavior.

proposals.note: Exact registered ScriptPacket handler for the R458 ConfirmationDialogInterface.

evidence.detail: R2 GamblingInterface constructs rs/n/c/W as its static ScriptPacketHandler endpoint.
The handler updates the GamblingInterface active/session timestamp flag and widget state used by the live gambling presentation.
Exact-current S2C250 authority identifies subtype 15 as gambling session/state; client evidence proves presentation/session state only, not RNG or settlement rules.

proposals.note: Exact client gambling presentation/state handler; no authoritative gambling odds or settlement semantics are inferred.

evidence.detail: Exact S2C250 authority registers rs/n/c/ah as subtype 9 ITEMS_KEPT_ON_DEATH_AUTOKEEP_SET with grammar u8 > u16_be.
R5 ItemsKeptOnDeathInterface constructs this handler as its static packet endpoint.
Selector 0 clears the interface's auto-keep Set<Integer>; selector 1 reads an item id and adds it, proving the narrow auto-keep-set role.

proposals.note: Name is deliberately narrower than the full Items Kept on Death domain: exact v308 proves only auto-keep presentation-set mutation.

evidence.detail: DonationShoppingCartInterface constructs rs/n/c/ax as its ScriptPacketHandler endpoint and pairs it with the rs/n/c/ay visual effect renderer.
Exact S2C250 authority registers rs/n/c/ax as subtype 36 with grammar u8 > u8 > u16_be > u8 > u8; older protocol work intentionally left its product noun unresolved.
Direct v308 bytecode shows every selector writes only rs/n/c/ay effect state: resets progress fields, clamps indexed values to 0..457, or sets one of three enum-like effect slots.

proposals.note: The donation-cart domain is fixed by exact parent/consumer ownership; the name remains presentation/effect-state scoped and does not infer purchase/business rules.

evidence.detail: DonationShoppingCartInterface owns the singleton rs/n/c/ay renderer and binds it to cart widgets including the 60249/60251 surface.
The renderer advances timed effect state, renders progress/effect presentation and creates rs/l/f/a/f/a particle objects through the live particle renderer/manager.
Its static progress/effect fields are the exclusive mutation target of subtype-36 rs/n/c/ax, proving the paired donation-cart effect renderer role.

proposals.note: Descriptive exact-v308 client presentation name; donation purchase/checkout semantics are outside this renderer.
